requirement.value: Cartomancer (Ace of Cards), Fury, Rogue, Sharpshooter or Prizefighter (Weaponmaster) mastery

system.description: When you resolve the Magic Pair effect, if you attack with a weapon belonging to the arcane, dagger, firearm, sword, or thrown Category, you deal extra damage equal to 【the common value of the resolved cards】 and regain an amount of Mind Points equal to 【twice the common value of the resolved cards】. For instance, resolving a pair of 5s will allow you to deal 5 extra damage and regain 10 Mind Points.
